metadata.question: Was there a noticeable larger bloom (represented by a brighter blue color) in Hood Canal in late August 2022, compared to August 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Hood Canal, WA (polygon around -123.3 to -122.95 lon, 47.3 to 47.75 lat).
- Time: Late August 2021 (2021-08-20 to 2021-08-31) vs Late August 2022 (2022-08-20 to 2022-08-31). If empty, widen to full August. If still empty, fallback to Landsat 8/9 SR.
- Collections: Primary COPERNICUS/S2_SR; fallback LANDSAT/LC08/LC09 C02 T1 L2.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds/cirrus: QA60 (S2) and QA_PIXEL bits (Landsat).
- Water-only using JRC Global Surface Water occurrence > 50%. This also stabilizes cloud % calculation.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after fallback: C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 in any period: C2.
- If computed metrics are null/NaN/out of range: C3.
- Otherwise compare NCI (cyan-ness) metrics; if 2022 > 2021 by set thresholds, answer Yes; else No.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[-123.30, 47.30], [-122.95, 47.30], [-122.95, 47.75], [-123.30, 47.75], [-123.30, 47.30]]
  ], null, false);
  const scale = 1000; // per best practices
  const periods = [
    {label: '2021', start: '2021-08-20', end: '2021-08-31', altStart: '2021-08-01', altEnd: '2021-08-31'},
    {label: '2022', start: '2022-08-20', end: '2022-08-31', altStart: '2022-08-01', altEnd: '2022-08-31'}
  ];
  const thrNCI = 0.10;

  // Water mask from JRC Global Surface Water (stable water)
  const gsw = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence');
  const waterMask = gsw.gt(50).selfMask();

  // Helper: Sentinel-2 cloud mask and scaling
  function prepS2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0));
    const scaled = img.select(['B2','B3','B4','B8']).multiply(0.0001).clamp(0, 1);
    return scaled.updateMask(cloud.not());
  }
  function s2Collection(s, e) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .filterDate(s, e)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
      .map(prepS2);
  }

  // Helper: Landsat 8/9 cloud mask and scaling
  function prepLx(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).eq(0)
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<4).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<5).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<7).eq(0));
    const scaled = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5'])
      .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2).clamp(0,1);
    return scaled.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function landsatCollection(s, e) {
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(s, e).map(prepLx);
    const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(s, e).map(prepLx);
    return l8.merge(l9);
  }

  // Cyan-ness index (NCI): higher -> brighter blue/cyan relative to red
  function addNCI(img, bands) {
    const B2 = img.select(bands.blue);
    const B3 = img.select(bands.green);
    const B4 = img.select(bands.red);
    const nci = B2.add(B3).subtract(B4.multiply(2))
      .divide(B2.add(B3).add(B4.multiply(2)).add(1e-6)).rename('NCI');
    return img.addBands(nci);
  }

  async function analyzePeriod(p) {
    // Try S2 first
    let src = 'S2';
    let col = s2Collection(p.start, p.end);
    let n = await col.size().getInfo();
    let widened = false;
    if (n === 0) {
      col = s2Collection(p.altStart, p.altEnd);
      n = await col.size().getInfo();
      widened = true;
    }
    // If still empty, try Landsat
    if (n === 0) {
      src = 'Landsat';
      col = landsatCollection(p.start, p.end);
      n = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (n === 0) {
        col = landsatCollection(p.altStart, p.altEnd);
        n = await col.size().getInfo();
        widened = true;
      }
      if (n === 0) {
        return {label: p.label, empty: true};
      }
      // Add NCI bands for Landsat
      col = col.map(img => addNCI(img, {blue:'SR_B2', green:'SR_B3', red:'SR_B4'}));
    } else {
      // Add NCI bands for S2
      col = col.map(img => addNCI(img, {blue:'B2', green:'B3', red:'B4'}));
    }

    // Median composite of NCI
    const nciComp = col.select('NCI').median();
    // Apply stable water mask
    const nciWater = nciComp.updateMask(waterMask);

    // Counts
    const waterCount = await waterMask.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('occurrence').getInfo();

    const validCount = await nciWater.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NCI').getInfo();

    if (!waterCount || waterCount === 0) {
      return {label: p.label, noValid: true, reason: 'No water pixels'};
    }
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      return {label: p.label, noValid: true, reason: 'No valid pixels'};
    }

    const stats = await nciWater.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({
        reducer2: ee.Reducer.percentile([95]),
        sharedInputs: true
      }),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();
    const mean = stats['NCI_mean'];
    const p95 = stats['NCI_p95'];

    // Area fraction above threshold
    const hiMask = nciWater.gt(thrNCI);
    const hiCount = await hiMask.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NCI').getInfo();
    const fracHigh = hiCount / validCount;

    const cloudPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 * (1 - validCount / waterCount)));
    const valid = isFinite(mean) && isFinite(p95) && isFinite(fracHigh);

    return {
      label: p.label,
      src: src + (widened ? ' (Aug)' : ''),
      nimgs: n,
      waterCount, validCount, cloudPct,
      mean, p95, fracHigh,
      empty: false, noValid: false, invalid: !valid
    };
  }

  try {
    console.log('Region: Hood Canal (WA), scale=1000m');

    const res1 = await analyzePeriod(periods[0]);
    const res2 = await analyzePeriod(periods[1]);

    // Handle error/empty cases
    if (res1.empty || res2.empty) {
      console.log(`Collections -> 2021: ${res1.empty ? 0 : res1.nimgs}, 2022: ${res2.empty ? 0 : res2.nimgs}`);
      console.log('Reason: Empty collection for at least one period.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }
    if (res1.noValid || res2.noValid) {
      console.log(`Valid pixels -> 2021: ${res1.validCount || 0}, 2022: ${res2.validCount || 0}`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }
    if (res1.invalid || res2.invalid || res1.mean === null || res2.mean === null) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`${res1.label} imgs: ${res1.nimgs} (${res1.src}); water px: ${res1.waterCount}; valid: ${res1.validCount} (cloud: ${res1.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`${res1.label} NCI mean: ${res1.mean.toFixed(3)}; p95: ${res1.p95.toFixed(3)}; >${thrNCI.toFixed(2)}: ${(100*res1.fracHigh).toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`${res2.label} imgs: ${res2.nimgs} (${res2.src}); water px: ${res2.waterCount}; valid: ${res2.validCount} (cloud: ${res2.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`${res2.label} NCI mean: ${res2.mean.toFixed(3)}; p95: ${res2.p95.toFixed(3)}; >${thrNCI.toFixed(2)}: ${(100*res2.fracHigh).toFixed(1)}%`);

    // Decision logic
    const dMean = res2.mean - res1.mean;
    const dFrac = res2.fracHigh - res1.fracHigh;
    console.log(`Diffs -> mean: ${dMean.toFixed(3)}; high-area: ${(100*dFrac).toFixed(1)}%`);

    const noticeable = (dMean >= 0.050) || (dFrac >= 0.10);
    if (!isFinite(dMean) || !isFinite(dFrac)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
    } else if (noticeable) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D: Error');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
